newsitem.title: CHINA: Shenzhen Properties H1 net 4.97 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen Properties H1 net 4.97 mln yuan.

text.p: Shenzhen Properties & Resources Development (Group) Ltd posted net profits of 4.97 million yuan in the first half of 1997, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said .
Per-share net profits reached 0.009 yuan and turnover was 218.4 million yuan in the first six months, the exchange said in a notice after the market closed on Friday.
It did not specify whether the results were based in Chinese or international accounting standards and gave no comparative figures.

For the same period in 1996, the company posted net profits of 14.7 million yuan based on Chinese accounting standards. Figures calculated under international standards were not immediately available.
